```typescript
async function getServiceToken(): Promise<string> {
  // 1) Static token via env (preferred if provided)
  const staticToken = process.env.LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN?.trim();
  if (staticToken) return staticToken;

  // 2) Cached token from prior login
  if (cachedToken && cachedTokenExp && Date.now() < cachedTokenExp) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  // 3) Auto-login using service credentials
  const username = process.env.SERVICE_USERNAME?.trim();
  const password = process.env.SERVICE_PASSWORD?.trim();
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  if (!username || !password) {
    throw new Error('Missing SERVICE_USERNAME or SERVICE_PASSWORD');
  }

  const loginUrl = `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/auth/login`;
  const res = await fetch(loginUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`Service login failed: ${res.status} ${err}`);
  }

  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const token: string | undefined =
    body?.access_token || body?.token || body?.accessToken;
  const expiresInSec: number | undefined =
    body?.expires_in || body?.expiresIn || body?.exp; // best-effort

  if (!token) {
    throw new Error('Service login did not return access token');
  }

  cachedToken = token;
  // If we have expiry, set a grace period; else 5 minutes default
  cachedTokenExp =
    typeof expiresInSec === 'number'
      ? Date.now() + Math.max(0, expiresInSec - 30) * 1000
      : Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000;

  return token;
}

export async function GET() {
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  const target = `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/waiting-list`;

  // Try with token (static or auto-login)
  let token: string;
  try {
    token = await getServiceToken();
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: e?.message ?? 'Failed to resolve service token' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }

  let res = await fetch(target, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  // If unauthorized, try refresh once
  if (res.status === 401) {
    try {
      cachedToken = null;
      cachedTokenExp = null;
      token = await getServiceToken();
      res = await fetch(target, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
    } catch {
      // fallthrough; respond with original 401
    }
  }

  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
}
```

- Proxy akan:
  - Pakai `LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN` jika ada.
  - Jika tidak ada/expired: login ke `${BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/login` dengan `SERVICE_USERNAME` dan `SERVICE_PASSWORD`, simpan JWT di memori, lalu pakai untuk request.
  - Jika 401 dari backend, akan refresh token sekali dan retry.
- Perubahan diterapkan di:
  - `app/api/waiting-list/route.ts`
  - `app/api/waiting-list/[id]/route.ts`

- `.env.local` di `listing-ngebengkel` berisi:
  - BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:4000 (tanpa /api)
  - SERVICE_USERNAME=listing-user
  - SERVICE_PASSWORD=LisingUses11331
  - (opsional) LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN jika mau bypass auto-login
- Restart `npm run dev`.

Coba lagi buka:
- `http://localhost:3100/api/waiting-list`
- Jika masih error, kirim body error dari proxy (akan ada pesan “Service login failed…” atau alasan lain), nanti saya sesuaikan payload/endpoint login sesuai backend Anda.

- Duplikasi “/api/api/…” sudah saya tangani di proxy: sekarang target menyamakan prefix otomatis. Dengan BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:4000, proxy akan call ke http://localhost:4000/api/waiting-list; jika BACKEND_URL sudah berakhiran /api, tidak ditambah lagi.

- 401 “Invalid token” terjadi karena LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN kamu bukan JWT. Kamu sudah menaruh SERVICE_USERNAME dan SERVICE_PASSWORD; proxy sekarang akan auto-login ke /api/auth/login, cache JWT, dan retry saat 401.

Langkah cepat:
- Hapus LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN (atau kosongkan) dari .env.local agar proxy pasti memakai auto-login.
- Pastikan BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:4000 (tanpa /api).
- Restart npm run dev.
- Buka http://localhost:3100/api/waiting-list dan lihat hasilnya. Jika masih error, kirim pesan JSON-nya; saya sesuaikan payload login sesuai backend (mis. body mungkin perlu { email, password } bukan { username, password }).

**Cursor**

Masalahnya karena `sysApi` sedang memakai `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000/api`, lalu digabung dengan endpoint proxy `/api/waiting-list` → menjadi `http://localhost:4000/api/api/waiting-list`.

Pilih salah satu perbaikan (disarankan opsi A):

- A) Pakai proxy Next.js saja (tanpa base eksternal)
  - Hapus atau kosongkan `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` dari `.env.local` di `listing-ngebengkel`.
  - Restart `npm run dev`.
  - Pastikan `config/endpoints.ts` tetap:
    - `base: '/api/waiting-list'`
    - `byId: (id) => '/api/waiting-list/' + id`
  - Dengan ini, `sysApi` akan hit relative URL ke proxy: `http://localhost:3100/api/waiting-list`.

- B) Pakai direct backend (tanpa proxy)
  - Set `config/endpoints.ts` ke path backend asli (tanpa `/api` dobel): `base: '/waiting-list'`, `byId: '/waiting-list/${id}'`
  - Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000/api`
  - Lalu sisipkan token di sisi klien (tidak disarankan untuk token rahasia).

Rekomendasi: jalankan opsi A. Jadi, hapus `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` agar tidak terjadi concat `.../api/api/...`.

- Proxy login sekarang hit: POST {BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/login body: { username, password }.
- Jika backend kamu pakai path lain (mis. /api/auth/sign-in) atau field lain (mis. { email, password }), login akan gagal dan fetch berikutnya ikut gagal.

Kalau backend hidup tapi masih “fetch failed”:
- Beri saya path login yang benar dan bentuk payload yang benar (mis. { email, password } atau { username, password }), saya sesuaikan proxy agar auto-login sukses.

```typescript
  const password = process.env.SERVICE_PASSWORD?.trim();
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  const identity = serviceEmail || username;

  if (!identity || !password) {
    throw new Error('Missing SERVICE_EMAIL/SERVICE_USERNAME or SERVICE_PASSWORD');
  }

  const loginUrl = `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/auth/login`;
  const res = await fetch(loginUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(
      identity.includes('@')
        ? { email: identity, password }
        : { username: identity, password },
    ),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`Service login failed: ${res.status} ${err}`);
  }

  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const token: string | undefined =
    body?.access_token || body?.token || body?.accessToken;
  const expiresInSec: number | undefined =
    body?.expires_in || body?.expiresIn || body?.exp;

  if (!token) {
    throw new Error('Service login did not return access token');
  }

  cachedToken = token;
  cachedTokenExp =
    typeof expiresInSec === 'number'
      ? Date.now() + Math.max(0, expiresInSec - 30) * 1000
      : Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000;

  return token;
}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  context: { params: { id: string } },
) {
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';
  const id = context.params.id;

  let token: string;
  try {
    token = await getServiceToken();
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: e?.message ?? 'Failed to resolve service token' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }

  const baseTrim = base.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const apiBase = baseTrim.endsWith('/api') ? baseTrim : `${baseTrim}/api`;
  const target = `${apiBase}/waiting-list/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;

  let res = await fetch(target, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (res.status === 401) {
    try {
      cachedToken = null;
      cachedTokenExp = null;
      token = await getServiceToken();
      res = await fetch(target, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
    } catch {
      // fallthrough
    }
  }

  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useQuery, type UseQueryOptions } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { sysApi, extractErrorMessage } from '@/config/api';
import { SYS_ENDPOINTS } from '@/config/endpoints';
import type { WaitingListItem } from '@/lib/types/waitingList';

type WaitingListResponse = {
  message: string;
  data: WaitingListItem;
};

type WaitingListListResponse = {
  message: string;
  data: WaitingListItem[];
};

type WaitingListQueryOptions = Omit<
  UseQueryOptions<WaitingListItem, Error>,
  'queryKey' | 'queryFn'
>;

type WaitingListListQueryOptions = Omit<
  UseQueryOptions<WaitingListItem[], Error>,
  'queryKey' | 'queryFn'
>;

export const useWaitingList = (
  id: string | null,
  options?: WaitingListQueryOptions,
) => {
  const { enabled, ...restOptions } = options ?? {};

  return useQuery<WaitingListItem, Error>({
    queryKey: ['waiting-list', id],
    enabled: Boolean(id) && (enabled ?? true),
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!id) {
        throw new Error('ID waiting list wajib diisi.');
      }

      try {
        const { data } = await sysApi.get<unknown>(
          SYS_ENDPOINTS.waitingList.byId(id),
        );
        const payload = data as any;
        // Terima dua bentuk: { message, data } atau object langsung
        const item: WaitingListItem | undefined =
          (payload?.data as WaitingListItem | undefined) ??
          (payload as WaitingListItem | undefined);
        if (!item) {
          throw new Error('Gagal memuat data waiting list.');
        }
        return item;
      } catch (error) {
        throw new Error(
          extractErrorMessage(error, 'Gagal memuat data waiting list.'),
        );
      }
    },
    ...restOptions,
  });
};

export const useWaitingLists = (options?: WaitingListListQueryOptions) => {
  const { enabled, ...restOptions } = options ?? {};

  return useQuery<WaitingListItem[], Error>({
    queryKey: ['waiting-list', 'all'],
    enabled: enabled ?? true,
    queryFn: async () => {
      try {
        const { data } = await sysApi.get<unknown>(
          SYS_ENDPOINTS.waitingList.base,
        );
        const payload = data as any;
        // Terima dua bentuk: { message, data: [] } atau array langsung
        const list: WaitingListItem[] =
          (Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : payload?.data) ?? [];
        return list;
      } catch (error) {
        throw new Error(
          extractErrorMessage(error, 'Gagal memuat daftar waiting list.'),
        );
      }
    },
    ...restOptions,
  });
};
```

- Proxy sudah OK (mengembalikan array). Error UI terjadi karena hook mengharapkan bentuk { message, data }, padahal respons sekarang berupa array langsung.
- Saya sudah perbaiki `queryHooks/useWaitingList.ts`:
  - Detail: jika payload punya `data`, pakai itu; jika tidak, pakai objek langsung.
  - List: jika payload array, pakai apa adanya; jika objek, pakai `payload.data`; default [].
- Coba refresh UI. Error “Query data cannot be undefined” harus hilang dan daftar bengkel tampil.

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingCityFilter } from './BookingCityFilter';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch, BookingData } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

type BookingCTAProps = {
  variant?: BookingCTAVariant;
};

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: BookingCTAProps) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWaitingLists();
  const branches: BookingBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    return waitingLists.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      name: item.name,
      // Tampilkan city dan province berdampingan sesuai permintaan
      city:
        item.city && item.province
          ? `${String(item.city).trim()} • ${String(item.province).trim()}`
          : item.city?.trim() ?? null,
      district: item.district ?? null,
      address: item.address ?? null,
      phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
      company: {
        id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN',
        name: item.categoryName ?? item.name,
      },
      slots: [], // data waiting list belum punya slot harian
    }));
  }, [waitingLists]);
  const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState<string>('Semua Kota');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranch] = useState<BookingBranch | null>(null);

  const cities = useMemo(() => {
    const uniqueCities = new Set<string>();
    branches.forEach((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim();
      if (cityName) {
        uniqueCities.add(cityName);
      }
    });

    const priorityOrder = ['Jakarta', 'Bandung', 'Surabaya'];
    const ordered = priorityOrder.filter((city) => uniqueCities.has(city));
    const remaining = Array.from(uniqueCities).filter((city) => !priorityOrder.includes(city));

    return [...ordered, ...remaining.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))];
  }, [branches]);

  const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    return branches.filter((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim() ?? 'Kota Lainnya';
      const matchesCity = selectedCity === 'Semua Kota' || selectedCity === cityName;
      const matchesSearch =
        normalizedSearch.length === 0 ||
        branch.company.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch);

      return matchesCity && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm, selectedCity]);

  const isDialog = variant === 'dialog';

  return (
    <section
      className={
        isDialog
          ? 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'
          : 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]'
      }
    >
      <div
        className={
          isDialog
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
            Booking Mudah
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">
            Pilih Bengkel &amp; Jadwalkan Servis Tanpa Ribet
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Temukan bengkel terdekat yang terintegrasi dengan jaringan Ngebengkel. Cukup pilih kota,
            cari nama grup, dan amankan slot servis yang tersedia.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-blue-50 p-4 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#045693]/80">
            Disclaimer: Data bengkel dan ketersediaan slot pada halaman ini masih bersifat simulatif
            untuk keperluan demonstrasi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Cari Bengkel
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Pilih Kota
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingCityFilter
                  cities={cities}
                  selectedCity={selectedCity}
                  onSelectCity={(city) => {
                    setSelectedCity(city);
                    setActiveBranch(null);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {activeBranch && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-primary/5 p-5 shadow-sm">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-primary">
                Bengkel Terpilih
              </p>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{activeBranch.name}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {activeBranch.company.name} • {activeBranch.city ?? 'Kota Lainnya'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Daftar Bengkel
          </p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} onBranchClick={setActiveBranch} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```typescript
    typeof expiresInSec === 'number'

      : Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000;
  return token;
}

      res = await fetch(target, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

let cachedToken: string | null = null;
let cachedTokenExp: number | null = null;

async function getServiceToken(): Promise<string> {
  const staticToken = process.env.LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN?.trim();
  if (staticToken) return staticToken;

  if (cachedToken && cachedTokenExp && Date.now() < cachedTokenExp) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  const username = process.env.SERVICE_USERNAME?.trim();
  const serviceEmail = process.env.SERVICE_EMAIL?.trim();
  const password = process.env.SERVICE_PASSWORD?.trim();
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  const identity = serviceEmail || username;
  if (!identity || !password) {
    throw new Error('Missing SERVICE_EMAIL/SERVICE_USERNAME or SERVICE_PASSWORD');
  }

  const loginUrl = `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/auth/login`;
  const res = await fetch(loginUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(
      identity.includes('@')
        ? { email: identity, password }
        : { username: identity, password },
    ),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`Service login failed: ${res.status} ${err}`);
  }

  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const token: string | undefined =
    body?.access_token || body?.token || body?.accessToken;
  const expiresInSec: number | undefined =
    body?.expires_in || body?.expiresIn || body?.exp;
  if (!token) throw new Error('Service login did not return access token');

  cachedToken = token;
  cachedTokenExp =
    typeof expiresInSec === 'number'
      ? Date.now() + Math.max(0, expiresInSec - 30) * 1000
      : Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000;
  return token;
}

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  context: { params: { id: string } },
) {
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';
  const id = context.params.id;

  let token: string;
  try {
    token = await getServiceToken();
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: e?.message ?? 'Failed to resolve service token' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }

  const baseTrim = base.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const apiBase = baseTrim.endsWith('/api') ? baseTrim : `${baseTrim}/api`;
  const target = `${apiBase}/sys_district/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;

  let res = await fetch(target, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (res.status === 401) {
    try {
      cachedToken = null;
      cachedTokenExp = null;
      token = await getServiceToken();
      res = await fetch(target, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingCityFilter } from './BookingCityFilter';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch, BookingData } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

type BookingCTAProps = {
  variant?: BookingCTAVariant;
};

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: BookingCTAProps) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWaitingLists();
  const [cityNameMap, setCityNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [provinceNameMap, setProvinceNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [districtNameMap, setDistrictNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!waitingLists || waitingLists.length === 0) return;
    const uniqueCity = new Set<string>();
    const uniqueProvince = new Set<string>();
    const uniqueDistrict = new Set<string>();
    for (const item of waitingLists) {
      if (item.city) uniqueCity.add(item.city.trim());
      if (item.province) uniqueProvince.add(item.province.trim());
      if (item.district) uniqueDistrict.add(item.district.trim());
    }
    const fetchAll = async () => {
      const [cityEntries, provEntries, distEntries] = await Promise.all([
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(uniqueCity).map(async (code) => {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/sys_city/${encodeURIComponent(code)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            const name: string | undefined = data?.data?.name ?? data?.name;
            return [code, name ?? code] as const;
          }),
        ),
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(uniqueProvince).map(async (code) => {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/sys_province/${encodeURIComponent(code)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            const name: string | undefined = data?.data?.name ?? data?.name;
            return [code, name ?? code] as const;
          }),
        ),
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(uniqueDistrict).map(async (code) => {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/sys_district/${encodeURIComponent(code)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            const name: string | undefined = data?.data?.name ?? data?.name;
            return [code, name ?? code] as const;
          }),
        ),
      ]);
      setCityNameMap(Object.fromEntries(cityEntries));
      setProvinceNameMap(Object.fromEntries(provEntries));
      setDistrictNameMap(Object.fromEntries(distEntries));
    };
    void fetchAll();
  }, [waitingLists]);
  const branches: BookingBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    return waitingLists.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      name: item.name,
      // Tampilkan city dan province berdampingan sesuai permintaan
      city:
        item.city && item.province
          ? `${(cityNameMap[item.city.trim()] ?? item.city).toString()} • ${(provinceNameMap[item.province.trim()] ?? item.province).toString()}`
          : (item.city ? (cityNameMap[item.city.trim()] ?? item.city) : null),
      district: item.district ?? null,
      address: item.address ?? null,
      phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
      company: {
        id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN',
        name: item.categoryName ?? item.name,
      },
      slots: [], // data waiting list belum punya slot harian
      // sisipkan properti tambahan untuk UI
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    } as any)).map((branch, idx) => {
      const src = waitingLists[idx];
      (branch as any).typeName =
        Array.isArray(src.workshopTypes) && src.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? src.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : null;
      (branch as any).districtName =
        src.district ? districtNameMap[src.district.trim()] ?? src.district : null;
      return branch as BookingBranch;
    });
  }, [waitingLists, cityNameMap, provinceNameMap, districtNameMap]);
  const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState<string>('Semua Kota');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranch] = useState<BookingBranch | null>(null);

  const cities = useMemo(() => {
    const uniqueCities = new Set<string>();
    branches.forEach((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim();
      if (cityName) {
        uniqueCities.add(cityName);
      }
    });

    const priorityOrder = ['Jakarta', 'Bandung', 'Surabaya'];
    const ordered = priorityOrder.filter((city) => uniqueCities.has(city));
    const remaining = Array.from(uniqueCities).filter((city) => !priorityOrder.includes(city));

    return [...ordered, ...remaining.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))];
  }, [branches]);

  const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    return branches.filter((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim() ?? 'Kota Lainnya';
      const matchesCity = selectedCity === 'Semua Kota' || selectedCity === cityName;
      const matchesSearch =
        normalizedSearch.length === 0 ||
        branch.company.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch);

      return matchesCity && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm, selectedCity]);

  const isDialog = variant === 'dialog';

  return (
    <section
      className={
        isDialog
          ? 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'
          : 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]'
      }
    >
      <div
        className={
          isDialog
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
            Booking Mudah
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">
            Pilih Bengkel &amp; Jadwalkan Servis Tanpa Ribet
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Temukan bengkel terdekat yang terintegrasi dengan jaringan Ngebengkel. Cukup pilih kota,
            cari nama grup, dan amankan slot servis yang tersedia.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-blue-50 p-4 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#045693]/80">
            Disclaimer: Data bengkel dan ketersediaan slot pada halaman ini masih bersifat simulatif
            untuk keperluan demonstrasi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Cari Bengkel
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Pilih Kota
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingCityFilter
                  cities={cities}
                  selectedCity={selectedCity}
                  onSelectCity={(city) => {
                    setSelectedCity(city);
                    setActiveBranch(null);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {activeBranch && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-primary/5 p-5 shadow-sm">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-primary">
                Bengkel Terpilih
              </p>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{activeBranch.name}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {activeBranch.company.name} • {activeBranch.city ?? 'Kota Lainnya'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Daftar Bengkel
          </p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} onBranchClick={setActiveBranch} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

Cukup refresh halaman. Jika nama wilayah belum muncul, kemungkinan endpoint referensi mengembalikan bentuk data berbeda; kirim satu contoh respon dari `/api/sys_city/<kode>`, `/api/sys_province/<kode>`, `/api/sys_district/<kode>` agar saya sesuaikan pemetaan key `name`.

---

**Cursor**

- 403 untuk `/api/sys_city/*` dan `/api/sys_province/*` artinya token service-account (listing-user) tidak punya izin READ ke endpoint referensi tersebut. 500 di `/api/sys_district/*` kemungkinan efek samping (guard/handler melempar error). Solusi:
  - Beri izin role READ ke endpoint `sys_province`, `sys_city`, `sys_district`, atau
  - Lebih baik: backend `waiting-list` ikut mengembalikan field terdenormalisasi: `provinceName`, `cityName`, `districtName`, `typeName` (join sekali di server), sehingga frontend tidak perlu memanggil `sys_*`.
  - Alternatif cepat: buat proxy login dengan akun yang punya izin untuk `sys_*` (bukan listing-user), tapi ini kurang ideal.

- Type belum tampil karena data `workshopTypes` kosong di respons waiting-list Anda. Itu terjadi jika `typeId` tidak di-set pada record (atau relasi belum di-load). Untuk menampilkan Type:
  - Pastikan record `wks_waitingList.type_id` terisi.
  - Atau di backend `waiting-list` ubah select/relasi agar `types` ter-load dan dipetakan menjadi `workshopTypes` (kita sudah lakukan), lalu pastikan role READ boleh baca relasi itu.

Rekomendasi paling bersih:
- Backend: tambah kolom output di `WaitingListResponseDto`:
  - `provinceName`, `cityName`, `districtName`, `typeName`
- Service: saat `findAll/findOne`, lakukan lookup nama (via join/relasi atau query tambahan) dan isi field tersebut.
- Frontend: gunakan field nama langsung; hapus pemanggilan `/api/sys_*`.

Mau saya langsung ubah service `waiting-list` agar mengembalikan `provinceName`, `cityName`, `districtName`, dan `typeName`? Setelah itu di UI saya ganti render agar memakai field tersebut dan menghapus fetch ke `sys_*`.

---

**User**

Beri izin role READ ke endpoint sys_province, sys_city, sys_district, dan sys_SubDistrict saja

---

**Cursor**

Saya akan cek controller sys_* untuk melihat mekanisme guard/roles yang dipakai, lalu menambahkan izin role READ pada GET endpoints. Setelah itu, saya akan terapkan yang sama untuk city, district, dan subdistrict.

Baik. Ada dua cara yang langsung menyelesaikan 403 untuk sys_province/sys_city/sys_district/sys_subdistrict:

- Paling aman untuk sekarang: tandai semua endpoint GET sys_* sebagai public
  - Pastikan setiap handler GET (list, byId, byRelation) diberi `@Public()` dan guard global Anda (`BetterJwtAuthGuard`) memang menghormati metadata public (key: `isPublic`).
  - Dari file yang Anda buka, `sys_city`, `sys_district`, `sys_subdistrict` GET sudah `@Public()`. Yakinkan `BetterJwtAuthGuard` benar-benar skip jika `isPublic === true`. Jika belum, tambahkan pengecekan metadata itu di guard.

- Jika Anda memang ingin tetap guarded namun accessible oleh role READ
  - Tambahkan decorator role READ pada semua GET sys_*:
    - Import decorator role READ (mis. `import { Roles } from '...';` atau `import { READ } from '...';` sesuai proyek Anda).
    - Tambahkan di semua GET handler sys_*: `@Roles('READ')` atau `@READ()`.
  - Pastikan guard role Anda membaca metadata role tersebut.

Catatan dari kode Anda:
- `sys_city`, `sys_district`, `sys_subdistrict` GET sudah `@Public()` → mestinya tidak kena 403 jika guard menghormati `@Public`.
- `sys_province` GET by id memakai `@Public()` dan `@READ()` tapi tidak terlihat import untuk `@READ()`; pastikan decorator tersebut ada dan di-import. Jika tidak, hapus `@READ()` atau ganti `@Roles('READ')` yang di-import benar.

Rekomendasi cepat:
- Pastikan `BetterJwtAuthGuard` punya logika:
  - Jika `this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>('isPublic', ...)` true → return true (skip).
- Jika tetap ingin role READ saja: tambahkan `@Roles('READ')` (atau `@READ()`) di semua GET sys_* dan pastikan guard role menangani metadata itu.

Setelah perbaikan, Anda tidak perlu lagi memanggil endpoint referensi dengan akun yang lebih tinggi; proxy dengan service-account READ akan lolos.

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Param,
  Post,
  Put,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Public } from '../../auth/decorators/public.decorator';
import { ThrottleGetEndpoints } from '../../auth/decorators/throttle.decorator';
import { Sys_CityService } from './sys_City.service';
import { Sys_CreateCityDto } from './dto/sys_CreateCity.dto';
import { Sys_UpdateCityDto } from './dto/sys_UpdateCity.dto';
import { Sys_ResponseCityDto } from './dto/sys_ResponseCity.dto';

@Controller('sys_city')
export class sys_CityController {
  constructor(private readonly cityService: Sys_CityService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(@Body() dto: Sys_CreateCityDto): Promise<Sys_ResponseCityDto> {
    return this.cityService.create(dto);
  }

  @Public()
  @READ()
  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get()
  async findAll(): Promise<Sys_ResponseCityDto[]> {
    return this.cityService.findAll();
  }

  @Public()
  @READ()
  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get('province/:province_id')
  async findByProvince(
    @Param('province_id') province_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseCityDto[]> {
    return this.cityService.findByProvinceId(province_id);
  }

  @Public()
  @READ()
  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<Sys_ResponseCityDto> {
    return this.cityService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Put(':id')
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: Sys_UpdateCityDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseCityDto> {
    return this.cityService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.cityService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

```typescript
  @Public()
```

- Proxy `listing-ngebengkel` yang memakai service-account READ seharusnya bisa memanggil `/api/sys_*` tanpa 403.

  - Import:

  - Pakai:
    ```ts
    @Roles('READ')
    ```
  - Jika Anda menggunakan enum:
    ```ts
    import { Roles } from '../../auth/decorators/roles.decorator';
    import { Role } from '../../auth/constants/role.enum';
    @Roles(Role.READ)
    ```

```typescript
import {
```

```typescript
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Public } from '../../auth/decorators/public.decorator';
import { ThrottleGetEndpoints } from '../../auth/decorators/throttle.decorator';
import { Sys_SubDistrictService } from './sys_SubDistrict.service';
import { Sys_CreateSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_CreateSubDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_UpdateSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_UpdateSubDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_ResponseSubDistrict.dto';

@Controller('sys_subdistrict')
export class sys_SubDistrictController {
  constructor(private readonly subdistrictService: Sys_SubDistrictService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(
    @Body() dto: Sys_CreateSubDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.create(dto);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get()
  async findAll(
    @Query('district_id') district_id?: string,
    @Query('city_id') city_id?: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    if (district_id) {
      return this.subdistrictService.findByDistrictId(district_id);
    }

    if (city_id) {
      return this.subdistrictService.findByCityId(city_id);
    }

    return this.subdistrictService.findAll();
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get('district/:district_id')
  async findByDistrict(
    @Param('district_id') district_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findByDistrictId(district_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get('city/:city_id')
  async findByCity(
    @Param('city_id') city_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findByCityId(city_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Put(':id')
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: Sys_UpdateSubDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.subdistrictService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

403 itu karena RolesGuard menolak akses: setelah kita hapus @Public dan @READ, endpoint GET sys_* tidak punya metadata role, sehingga guard menganggap “Forbidden resource”.

Solusi yang benar untuk “authenticated + RBAC READ”:
- Tambahkan decorator role pada semua GET sys_*:
  - Import Roles: `import { Roles } from '../../auth/decorators/roles.decorator';`
  - Pakai: `@Roles('READ')` di:
    - sys_province: GET /sys_province, GET /sys_province/:id
    - sys_city: GET /sys_city, GET /sys_city/province/:province_id, GET /sys_city/:id
    - sys_district: GET /sys_district, GET /sys_district/city/:city_id, GET /sys_district/:id
    - sys_subdistrict: GET /sys_subdistrict, GET /sys_subdistrict/district/:district_id, GET /sys_subdistrict/city/:city_id, GET /sys_subdistrict/:id
- Pastikan user `listing-user` punya `role_id=READ`.
- Restart backend.

- Pastikan import:

- Biarkan guard Anda memakai `getAllAndOverride` agar method-level READ menimpa class-level ADMIN.

**Cursor**

- Saya sudah menambahkan decorator method-level `@Roles('READ')` pada SEMUA endpoint GET `sys_province/sys_city/sys_district/sys_subdistrict` agar tidak mewarisi role kelas. Itu yang saya ubah.

Mengapa masih 403?
- RolesGuard Anda kemungkinan membaca metadata kelas dan method dengan “merge”, bukan “override”, sehingga role kelas `ADMIN` tetap ikut dihitung. Atau guard memang mengharuskan `ADMIN` walau ada `READ`.

Solusi cepat (pilih salah satu):
- Tambahkan method-level: `@Roles('ADMIN','READ')` di semua GET sys_* (aman jika guard melakukan merge).
- Atau perbaiki RolesGuard supaya pakai “override”:
  - Gunakan `this.reflector.getAllAndOverride(ROLES_KEY, [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()])` sehingga metadata method menimpa kelas.

```typescript
@Controller('sys_province')
export class sys_ProvinceController {

    return this.provinceService.create(dto);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get()
  async findAll(): Promise<Sys_ResponseProvinceDto[]> {
    return this.provinceService.findAll();
  }

  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<Sys_ResponseProvinceDto> {

  }
}
```

```typescript
@Controller('sys_district')
export class sys_DistrictController {

  async create(
    @Body() dto: Sys_CreateDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseDistrictDto> {
    return this.districtService.create(dto);
  }

  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')

  @Get(':id')

  }

    return this.districtService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Sys_SubDistrictService } from './sys_SubDistrict.service';
import { Sys_CreateSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_CreateSubDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_UpdateSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_UpdateSubDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_ResponseSubDistrict.dto';

@Controller('sys_subdistrict')
export class sys_SubDistrictController {
  constructor(private readonly subdistrictService: Sys_SubDistrictService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(
    @Body() dto: Sys_CreateSubDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.create(dto);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get()
  async findAll(
    @Query('district_id') district_id?: string,
    @Query('city_id') city_id?: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    if (district_id) {
      return this.subdistrictService.findByDistrictId(district_id);
    }

    if (city_id) {
      return this.subdistrictService.findByCityId(city_id);
    }

    return this.subdistrictService.findAll();
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get('district/:district_id')
  async findByDistrict(
    @Param('district_id') district_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findByDistrictId(district_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get('city/:city_id')
  async findByCity(
    @Param('city_id') city_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findByCityId(city_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Put(':id')
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: Sys_UpdateSubDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.subdistrictService.remove(id);
  }
}

```

Sudah. Saya set semua endpoint GET sys_* ke `@Roles('ADMIN','READ')` agar lolos jika guard melakukan merge metadata:

- `sys_Province.controller.ts`
  - GET /sys_province → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_province/:id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
- `sys_City.controller.ts`
  - GET /sys_city → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_city/province/:province_id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_city/:id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
- `sys_District.controller.ts`
  - GET /sys_district → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_district/city/:city_id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_district/:id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
- `sys_SubDistrict.controller.ts`
  - GET /sys_subdistrict → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_subdistrict/district/:district_id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_subdistrict/city/:city_id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  - GET /sys_subdistrict/:id → @Roles('ADMIN','READ')

Restart backend, lalu coba lagi call `/api/sys_city/31730` dsb. Jika masih 403, berarti RolesGuard Anda tidak membaca metadata method-level; saat itu solusinya ganti guard menggunakan `this.reflector.getAllAndOverride(ROLES_KEY, [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()])` atau pastikan token benar-benar berisi role “READ” atau “ADMIN”.

**Cursor**

Masih 403 karena RolesGuard Anda tidak “meng-override” role level-kelas dengan role level-method. Akibatnya, walau method sudah @Roles('ADMIN','READ'), guard tetap mengambil metadata kelas (ADMIN) atau melakukan pengecekan yang mensyaratkan SEMUA required roles ada, bukan SALAH SATU.

Perbaikan singkat yang pasti tembus:
- Ubah BetterRolesGuard agar:
  1) Memakai getAllAndOverride (method override class)
  2) Memakai cek “some” (salah satu role cukup)

Contoh inti di guard (logika canActivate), cukup ringkas:
```ts
const required = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>(
  ROLES_KEY,
  [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()],
);
if (!required?.length) return true;

const userRole = user.role_id?.trim(); // pastikan tanpa spasi
return required.some((r) => r === userRole);
```

Jika Anda ingin cepat tanpa menyentuh guard:
- Tambahkan juga @Roles('ADMIN','READ') di level kelas untuk semua controller sys_* (selain sudah di method). Ini meniadakan konflik metadata ADMIN di kelas. Namun ini hanya workaround; yang ideal tetap memperbaiki guard seperti di atas.

Ringkas tindakan yang perlu:
- Ideal: perbaiki BetterRolesGuard seperti snippet di atas.
- Alternatif cepat: tambahkan @Roles('ADMIN','READ') di atas kelas `@Controller('sys_city')`, `sys_province`, `sys_district`, `sys_subdistrict` lalu restart backend.

Setelah itu, request GET ke `/api/sys_city/31730` dengan token role READ akan 200.

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  Param,
  Post,
  Put,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Public } from '../../auth/decorators/public.decorator';
import { Roles } from '../../auth/decorators/roles.decorator';
import { ThrottleGetEndpoints } from '../../auth/decorators/throttle.decorator';
import { Sys_DistrictService } from './sys_District.service';
import { Sys_CreateDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_CreateDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_UpdateDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_UpdateDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_ResponseDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_ResponseDistrict.dto';

@Roles('ADMIN','READ')
@Controller('sys_district')
export class sys_DistrictController {
  constructor(private readonly districtService: Sys_DistrictService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(
    @Body() dto: Sys_CreateDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseDistrictDto> {
    return this.districtService.create(dto);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get()
  async findAll(
    @Query('city_id') city_id?: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseDistrictDto[]> {
    if (city_id) {
      return this.districtService.findByCityId(city_id);
    }

    return this.districtService.findAll();
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get('city/:city_id')
  async findByCity(
    @Param('city_id') city_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.districtService.findByCityId(city_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<Sys_ResponseDistrictDto> {
    return this.districtService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Put(':id')
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: Sys_UpdateDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseDistrictDto> {
    return this.districtService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.districtService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,

  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Public } from '../../auth/decorators/public.decorator';
import { Roles } from '../../auth/decorators/roles.decorator';
import { ThrottleGetEndpoints } from '../../auth/decorators/throttle.decorator';
import { Sys_SubDistrictService } from './sys_SubDistrict.service';
import { Sys_CreateSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_CreateSubDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_UpdateSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_UpdateSubDistrict.dto';
import { Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto } from './dto/sys_ResponseSubDistrict.dto';

@Roles('ADMIN','READ')
@Controller('sys_subdistrict')
export class sys_SubDistrictController {
  constructor(private readonly subdistrictService: Sys_SubDistrictService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(
    @Body() dto: Sys_CreateSubDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.create(dto);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Get()
  async findAll(
    @Query('district_id') district_id?: string,
    @Query('city_id') city_id?: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    if (district_id) {
      return this.subdistrictService.findByDistrictId(district_id);
    }

    if (city_id) {
      return this.subdistrictService.findByCityId(city_id);
    }

    return this.subdistrictService.findAll();
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get('district/:district_id')
  async findByDistrict(
    @Param('district_id') district_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findByDistrictId(district_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get('city/:city_id')
  async findByCity(
    @Param('city_id') city_id: string,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto[]> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findByCityId(city_id);
  }

  @ThrottleGetEndpoints() // 100 requests per minute
  @Roles('ADMIN','READ')
  @Get(':id')
  async findOne(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Put(':id')
  async update(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() dto: Sys_UpdateSubDistrictDto,
  ): Promise<Sys_ResponseSubDistrictDto> {
    return this.subdistrictService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  async remove(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.subdistrictService.remove(id);
  }
}
```

  - `sys_province`, `sys_city`, `sys_district`, `sys_subdistrict`
  - (sebelumnya method-level sudah di-set)

- 429 pada /api/auth/login terjadi karena auto-login terpanggil beberapa kali paralel saat nama wilayah di-fetch. Setelah peran beres dan token tersimpan, panggilan login tidak akan terulang. Jika masih terjadi, kita bisa tambah debouncing/in-flight lock di proxy login.

Silakan restart backend lalu coba lagi:
- GET melalui proxy: `/api/sys_city/31730`, `/api/sys_province/31000`, `/api/sys_district/317301`
- Jika masih 403, kirim log BetterRolesGuard (User Role, Required Roles) terbaru.

**Cursor**

401 “No token provided” artinya request GET kamu ke sys_* tidak membawa header Authorization.

Cek ini di Postman:
- Header Wajib
  - Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>
  - Content-Type: application/json
- Jangan pakai “JWT <token>”; harus “Bearer <token>”.
- Pastikan token belum expired (decode JWT, cek exp).
- Cek claim role di JWT: role_id harus persis “READ” (tanpa spasi). Jika token berisi padding/spasi dari kolom CHAR, guard bisa gagal.

Contoh uji cepat (ganti <token>):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" http://localhost:4000/api/sys_city/31730
```

Jika setelah header benar lalu 403:
- Berarti token terbaca tapi role tidak cocok. Kirim payload JWT (bagian claim) atau log BetterRolesGuard terbaru (User Role, Required Roles) agar saya sesuaikan.

```shellscript
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" http://localhost:4000/api/sys_city/31730
```

**Cursor**

Penyebabnya masih dua hal sekaligus:
1) Proxy kamu sering login (kena 429), sehingga beberapa panggilan ke sys_* gagal dan jatuh ke 403/500.
2) Roles metadata yang dibaca guard untuk route sys_* masih “ADMIN” saja (bukan ['ADMIN','READ']), artinya metadata READ method/class belum benar-benar di-pick up.

Lakukan ini supaya beres total:
- Pakai token tetap agar proxy tidak login terus:
  - Set LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN di .env.local (listing-ngebengkel) dengan JWT sukses dari Postman (accessToken), lalu restart npm run dev. Ini meniadakan 429 dan memastikan semua call sys_* selalu membawa token.
- Verifikasi metadata roles yang dibaca guard:
  - Hantam GET sys_city/31730 lagi dan lihat log BetterRolesGuard. Idealnya:
    - Required Roles: ['ADMIN','READ']
    - User Role: READ
    - Has required role: true
  - Jika masih “Required Roles: ['ADMIN']”:
    - Pastikan semua controller sys_* mengimpor Roles dari path yang sama: ../../auth/decorators/roles.decorator
    - Pastikan di setiap controller:
      - Di level KELAS: @Roles('ADMIN','READ') tepat di atas @Controller(...)
      - Di level METHOD GET (list/byId/byRelation): @Roles('ADMIN','READ') ada juga
    - Tidak ada decorator lain yang set @Roles('ADMIN') di class (atau “base controller”) yang menimpa.

Catatan:
- 401 di browser untuk http://localhost:4000/api/sys_province/31000 itu normal (tanpa header). Tes via proxy Next: http://localhost:3100/api/sys_province/31000 (proxy akan sisipkan token LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN).
- Setelah LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN di-set ke JWT valid dan roles metadata terbaca sebagai ['ADMIN','READ'], UI akan menampilkan nama kota/provinsi/kecamatan dan type dengan stabil.

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

let cachedToken: string | null = null;
let cachedTokenExp: number | null = null;

async function getServiceToken(): Promise<string> {
  const staticToken = process.env.LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN?.trim();
  if (staticToken) return staticToken;

  if (cachedToken && cachedTokenExp && Date.now() < cachedTokenExp) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  const username = process.env.SERVICE_USERNAME?.trim();
  const serviceEmail = process.env.SERVICE_EMAIL?.trim();
  const password = process.env.SERVICE_PASSWORD?.trim();
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  const identity = serviceEmail || username;
  if (!identity || !password) {
    throw new Error('Missing SERVICE_EMAIL/SERVICE_USERNAME or SERVICE_PASSWORD');
  }

  const loginUrl = `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/auth/login`;
  const res = await fetch(loginUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(
      identity.includes('@')
        ? { email: identity, password }
        : { username: identity, password },
    ),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`Service login failed: ${res.status} ${err}`);
  }

  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const token: string | undefined =
    body?.access_token || body?.token || body?.accessToken;
  const expiresInSec: number | undefined =
    body?.expires_in || body?.expiresIn || body?.exp;
  if (!token) throw new Error('Service login did not return access token');

  cachedToken = token;
  cachedTokenExp =
    typeof expiresInSec === 'number'
      ? Date.now() + Math.max(0, expiresInSec - 30) * 1000
      : Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000;
  return token;
}

export async function GET() {
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  let token: string;
  try {
    token = await getServiceToken();
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: e?.message ?? 'Failed to resolve service token' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }

  const baseTrim = base.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const apiBase = baseTrim.endsWith('/api') ? baseTrim : `${baseTrim}/api`;
  const target = `${apiBase}/sys_province`;

  let res = await fetch(target, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (res.status === 401) {
    try {
      cachedToken = null;
      cachedTokenExp = null;
      token = await getServiceToken();
      res = await fetch(target, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

let cachedToken: string | null = null;
let cachedTokenExp: number | null = null;

async function getServiceToken(): Promise<string> {
  const staticToken = process.env.LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN?.trim();
  if (staticToken) return staticToken;

  if (cachedToken && cachedTokenExp && Date.now() < cachedTokenExp) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  const username = process.env.SERVICE_USERNAME?.trim();
  const serviceEmail = process.env.SERVICE_EMAIL?.trim();
  const password = process.env.SERVICE_PASSWORD?.trim();
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  const identity = serviceEmail || username;
  if (!identity || !password) {
    throw new Error('Missing SERVICE_EMAIL/SERVICE_USERNAME or SERVICE_PASSWORD');
  }

  const loginUrl = `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/auth/login`;
  const res = await fetch(loginUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(
      identity.includes('@')
        ? { email: identity, password }
        : { username: identity, password },
    ),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`Service login failed: ${res.status} ${err}`);
  }

  const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));
  const token: string | undefined =
    body?.access_token || body?.token || body?.accessToken;
  const expiresInSec: number | undefined =
    body?.expires_in || body?.expiresIn || body?.exp;
  if (!token) throw new Error('Service login did not return access token');

  cachedToken = token;
  cachedTokenExp =
    typeof expiresInSec === 'number'
      ? Date.now() + Math.max(0, expiresInSec - 30) * 1000
      : Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000;
  return token;
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const base =
    process.env.BACKEND_URL ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
    'http://localhost:4000';

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const cityId = url.searchParams.get('city_id');

  let token: string;
  try {
    token = await getServiceToken();
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: e?.message ?? 'Failed to resolve service token' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }

  const baseTrim = base.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const apiBase = baseTrim.endsWith('/api') ? baseTrim : `${baseTrim}/api`;
  const target = cityId
    ? `${apiBase}/sys_district?city_id=${encodeURIComponent(cityId)}`
    : `${apiBase}/sys_district`;

  let res = await fetch(target, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (res.status === 401) {
    try {
      cachedToken = null;
      cachedTokenExp = null;
      token = await getServiceToken();
      res = await fetch(target, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState,useEffect } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingCityFilter } from './BookingCityFilter';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

type BookingCTAProps = {
  variant?: BookingCTAVariant;
};

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: BookingCTAProps) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWaitingLists();
  const [cityNameMap, setCityNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [provinceNameMap, setProvinceNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [districtNameMap, setDistrictNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!waitingLists || waitingLists.length === 0) return;
    const uniqueCity = new Set<string>();
    const uniqueProvince = new Set<string>();
    for (const item of waitingLists) {
      if (item.city) uniqueCity.add(item.city.trim());
      if (item.province) uniqueProvince.add(item.province.trim());
    }
    const fetchAll = async () => {
      // 1) Province list (berisi city name juga)
      const provRes = await fetch(`/api/sys_province`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      const provPayload = await provRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const provinces: Array<{ id: string; name: string; cities?: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> }> =
        Array.isArray(provPayload?.data) ? provPayload.data : Array.isArray(provPayload) ? provPayload : [];
      const provMap: Record<string, string> = {};
      const cityMap: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const p of provinces) {
        if (p?.id && p?.name) provMap[p.id.trim()] = p.name;
        if (Array.isArray(p?.cities)) {
          for (const c of p.cities) {
            if (c?.id && c?.name) cityMap[c.id.trim()] = c.name;
          }
        }
      }
      setProvinceNameMap(provMap);
      setCityNameMap(cityMap);

      // 2) Districts by city (loop kota unik)
      const distEntries: Array<[string, string]> = [];
      for (const cityId of uniqueCity) {
        const distRes = await fetch(`/api/sys_district?city_id=${encodeURIComponent(cityId)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        const distPayload = await distRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const districts: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> =
          Array.isArray(distPayload?.data) ? distPayload.data : Array.isArray(distPayload) ? distPayload : [];
        for (const d of districts) {
          if (d?.id && d?.name) distEntries.push([d.id.trim(), d.name]);
        }
      }
      setDistrictNameMap(Object.fromEntries(distEntries));
    };
    void fetchAll();
  }, [waitingLists]);
  const branches: BookingBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    return waitingLists.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      name: item.name,
      // Tampilkan city dan province berdampingan sesuai permintaan
      city:
        item.city && item.province
          ? `${(cityNameMap[item.city.trim()] ?? item.city).toString()} • ${(provinceNameMap[item.province.trim()] ?? item.province).toString()}`
          : (item.city ? (cityNameMap[item.city.trim()] ?? item.city) : null),
      district: item.district ?? null,
      address: item.address ?? null,
      phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
      company: {
        id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN',
        name: item.categoryName ?? item.name,
      },
      slots: [], // data waiting list belum punya slot harian
      // sisipkan properti tambahan untuk UI
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    } as any)).map((branch, idx) => {
      const src = waitingLists[idx];
      (branch as any).typeName =
        Array.isArray(src.workshopTypes) && src.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? src.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : null;
      (branch as any).districtName =
        src.district ? districtNameMap[src.district.trim()] ?? src.district : null;
      return branch as BookingBranch;
    });
  }, [waitingLists, cityNameMap, provinceNameMap, districtNameMap]);
  const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState<string>('Semua Kota');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranch] = useState<BookingBranch | null>(null);

  const cities = useMemo(() => {
    const uniqueCities = new Set<string>();
    branches.forEach((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim();
      if (cityName) {
        uniqueCities.add(cityName);
      }
    });

    const priorityOrder = ['Jakarta', 'Bandung', 'Surabaya'];
    const ordered = priorityOrder.filter((city) => uniqueCities.has(city));
    const remaining = Array.from(uniqueCities).filter((city) => !priorityOrder.includes(city));

    return [...ordered, ...remaining.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))];
  }, [branches]);

  const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    return branches.filter((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim() ?? 'Kota Lainnya';
      const matchesCity = selectedCity === 'Semua Kota' || selectedCity === cityName;
      const matchesSearch =
        normalizedSearch.length === 0 ||
        branch.company.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch);

      return matchesCity && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm, selectedCity]);

  const isDialog = variant === 'dialog';

  return (
    <section
      className={
        isDialog
          ? 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'
          : 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]'
      }
    >
      <div
        className={
          isDialog
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
            Booking Mudah
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">
            Pilih Bengkel &amp; Jadwalkan Servis Tanpa Ribet
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Temukan bengkel terdekat yang terintegrasi dengan jaringan Ngebengkel. Cukup pilih kota,
            cari nama grup, dan amankan slot servis yang tersedia.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-blue-50 p-4 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#045693]/80">
            Disclaimer: Data bengkel dan ketersediaan slot pada halaman ini masih bersifat simulatif
            untuk keperluan demonstrasi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Cari Bengkel
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Pilih Kota
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingCityFilter
                  cities={cities}
                  selectedCity={selectedCity}
                  onSelectCity={(city) => {
                    setSelectedCity(city);
                    setActiveBranch(null);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {activeBranch && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-primary/5 p-5 shadow-sm">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-primary">
                Bengkel Terpilih
              </p>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{activeBranch.name}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {activeBranch.company.name} • {activeBranch.city ?? 'Kota Lainnya'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Daftar Bengkel
          </p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} onBranchClick={setActiveBranch} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}



```

- Saya sudah mengubah UI agar tidak lagi memanggil endpoint per-id yang bermasalah. Sekarang:
  - Nama province dan city diambil dari list: GET `/api/sys_province` (proxy server-side).
  - Nama district diambil per kota unik: GET `/api/sys_district?city_id=<kode_kota>`.
- Saya menambahkan proxy baru:
  - `app/api/sys_province/route.ts` (list)
  - `app/api/sys_district/route.ts` (list + query city_id)
- `BookingCTA.tsx` telah saya update:
  - Build peta `provinceNameMap`, `cityNameMap` dari `/api/sys_province`.
  - Build `districtNameMap` dengan loop kota unik via `/api/sys_district?city_id=...`.
  - Render: City • Province dan District Name ditampilkan sebagai nama, bukan kode.

Harusnya sekarang UI menampilkan nama wilayah tanpa 403, karena kita gunakan endpoint list yang sudah lolos READ. Jika masih ada 429 login, isi `LISTING_SERVICE_TOKEN` dengan JWT sukses dari Postman agar proxy tidak login berulang.

```typescriptreact
      const provMap: Record<string, string> = {};

        const distRes = await fetch(`/api/sys_district?city_id=${encodeURIComponent(cityId)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        const distPayload = await distRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const districts: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> =
          Array.isArray(distPayload?.data) ? distPayload.data : Array.isArray(distPayload) ? distPayload : [];
        for (const d of districts) {
          if (d?.id && d?.name) distEntries.push([d.id.trim(), d.name]);
        }
      }
      setDistrictNameMap(Object.fromEntries(distEntries));
    };
    void fetchAll();
  }, [waitingLists]);
  const branches: BookingBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    return waitingLists.map((item) => ({
      id: item.id,
      name: item.name,
      // Tampilkan city dan province berdampingan sesuai permintaan
      city:
        item.city && item.province
          ? `${(cityNameMap[item.city.trim()] ?? item.city).toString()} • ${(provinceNameMap[item.province.trim()] ?? item.province).toString()}`
          : (item.city ? (cityNameMap[item.city.trim()] ?? item.city) : null),
      district: item.district ?? null,
      address: item.address ?? null,
      phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
      company: {
        id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN',
        name: item.categoryName ?? item.name,
      },
      slots: [], // data waiting list belum punya slot harian
      // sisipkan properti tambahan untuk UI
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    } as any)).map((branch, idx) => {
      const src = waitingLists[idx];
      (branch as any).typeName =
        Array.isArray(src.workshopTypes) && src.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? src.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : (src.categoryName ?? null);
      (branch as any).districtName =
        src.district ? districtNameMap[src.district.trim()] ?? src.district : null;
      return branch as BookingBranch;
    });
  }, [waitingLists, cityNameMap, provinceNameMap, districtNameMap]);
  const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState<string>('Semua Kota');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranch] = useState<BookingBranch | null>(null);

  const cities = useMemo(() => {
    const uniqueCities = new Set<string>();
    branches.forEach((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim();
      if (cityName) {
        uniqueCities.add(cityName);
      }
    });

    const priorityOrder = ['Jakarta', 'Bandung', 'Surabaya'];
    const ordered = priorityOrder.filter((city) => uniqueCities.has(city));
    const remaining = Array.from(uniqueCities).filter((city) => !priorityOrder.includes(city));

    return [...ordered, ...remaining.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))];
  }, [branches]);

  const types = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    (branches as Array<any>).forEach((b) => {
      const t = (b?.typeName ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (t.length > 0) s.add(t);
    });
    return Array.from(s).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [branches]);

  const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    return branches.filter((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim() ?? 'Kota Lainnya';
      const matchesCity = selectedCity === 'Semua Kota' || selectedCity === cityName;
      const typeName = (branch as any).typeName?.toString().trim() ?? '';
      const matchesType = selectedType === 'Semua Tipe' || selectedType === typeName;
      const matchesSearch =
        normalizedSearch.length === 0 ||
        branch.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
        branch.company.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
        typeName.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch);

      return matchesCity && matchesType && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm, selectedCity, selectedType]);

  const isDialog = variant === 'dialog';

  return (
    <section
      className={
        isDialog
          ? 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'
          : 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]'
      }
    >
      <div
        className={
          isDialog
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
            Booking Mudah
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">
            Pilih Bengkel &amp; Jadwalkan Servis Tanpa Ribet
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Temukan bengkel terdekat yang terintegrasi dengan jaringan Ngebengkel. Cukup pilih kota,
            cari nama grup, dan amankan slot servis yang tersedia.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-blue-50 p-4 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#045693]/80">
            Disclaimer: Data bengkel dan ketersediaan slot pada halaman ini masih bersifat simulatif
            untuk keperluan demonstrasi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Cari Bengkel
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Pilih Kota
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingCityFilter
                  cities={cities}
                  selectedCity={selectedCity}
                  onSelectCity={(city) => {
                    setSelectedCity(city);
                    setActiveBranch(null);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Pilih Tipe
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingTypeFilter
                  types={types}
                  selectedType={selectedType}
                  onSelectType={(t) => {
                    setSelectedType(t);
                    setActiveBranch(null);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {activeBranch && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-primary/5 p-5 shadow-sm">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-primary">
                Bengkel Terpilih
              </p>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{activeBranch.name}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {activeBranch.company.name} • {activeBranch.city ?? 'Kota Lainnya'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Daftar Bengkel
          </p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} onBranchClick={setActiveBranch} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}



```

```typescriptreact
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">

            {type}

      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```
