```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState,useEffect } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

type BookingCTAProps = {
  variant?: BookingCTAVariant;
};

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: BookingCTAProps) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWaitingLists();
  const [cityNameMap, setCityNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [provinceNameMap, setProvinceNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [districtNameMap, setDistrictNameMap] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<string>('Semua Tipe');

  useEffect(() => {
    // lokasi/tipe dihilangkan sementara; tidak perlu memuat referensi wilayah
  }, [waitingLists]);
  const branches: BookingBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    return waitingLists.map((item: any) => {
      const b: any = {
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        city: null,
        district: null,
        address: item.address ?? null,
        phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
        company: {
          id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN',
          name: item.categoryName ?? item.name,
        },
        slots: [],
      };
      if (item.promoPreview) b.promoPreview = item.promoPreview;
      return b as BookingBranch;
    });
  }, [waitingLists]);
  const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState<string>('Semua Kota');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranch] = useState<BookingBranch | null>(null);

  const cities = useMemo(() => {
    const uniqueCities = new Set<string>();
    branches.forEach((branch) => {
      const cityName = branch.city?.trim();
      if (cityName) {
        uniqueCities.add(cityName);
      }
    });

    const priorityOrder = ['Jakarta', 'Bandung', 'Surabaya'];
    const ordered = priorityOrder.filter((city) => uniqueCities.has(city));
    const remaining = Array.from(uniqueCities).filter((city) => !priorityOrder.includes(city));

    return [...ordered, ...remaining.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))];
  }, [branches]);

  const types = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    (branches as Array<any>).forEach((b) => {
      const t = (b?.typeName ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (t.length > 0) s.add(t);
    });
    return Array.from(s).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [branches]);

  const filteredBranches = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    const searchPromo = /\bpromo\b/.test(normalizedSearch);

    return (branches as any[]).filter((branch) => {
      const promoMatches =
        Array.isArray(branch.promos) &&
        branch.promos.some((p: any) =>
          [p?.title, p?.description]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .some((t) => t.toString().toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch)),
        );
      const hasPromo = Array.isArray(branch.promos) && branch.promos.length > 0;
      const matchesSearch =
        normalizedSearch.length === 0 ||
        branch.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
        branch.company.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
        promoMatches;
      if (searchPromo) {
        return hasPromo && matchesSearch;
      }
      return matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm]);

  const isDialog = variant === 'dialog';

  return (
    <section
      className={
        isDialog
          ? 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'
          : 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]'
      }
    >
      <div
        className={
          isDialog
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">
            Booking Mudah
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">
            Pilih Bengkel &amp; Jadwalkan Servis Tanpa Ribet
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Temukan bengkel terdekat yang terintegrasi dengan jaringan Ngebengkel. Cukup pilih kota,
            cari nama grup, dan amankan slot servis yang tersedia.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-blue-50 p-4 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#045693]/80">
            Disclaimer: Data bengkel dan ketersediaan slot pada halaman ini masih bersifat simulatif
            untuk keperluan demonstrasi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-6">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Cari Bengkel
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3">
                <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
              </div>
            </div>

            

            
          </div>

          {activeBranch && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-primary/5 p-5 shadow-sm">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-primary">
                Bengkel Terpilih
              </p>
              <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{activeBranch.name}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {activeBranch.company.name} • {activeBranch.city ?? 'Kota Lainnya'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Daftar Bengkel
          </p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} onBranchClick={setActiveBranch} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { BookingSlotList } from './BookingSlotList';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

type BookingBranchListProps = {
  branches: BookingBranch[];
  onBranchClick?: (branch: BookingBranch) => void;
};

export function BookingBranchList({ branches, onBranchClick }: BookingBranchListProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Tidak ada bengkel yang cocok dengan filter saat ini. Coba pilih kota lain atau sesuaikan
        kata kunci pencarian.
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      {branches.map((branch) => (
        <Card
          key={branch.id}
          className="border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#045693] hover:shadow-md"
        >
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-[#045693]/40 pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                  {branch.company.name}
                </p>
                <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {branch.name}
                </CardTitle>
              </div>
            </div>
            {(branch.address || branch.district) && (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {[branch.address, branch.district].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
              </p>
            )}
            {branch.phone && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.phone}</p>}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-4">
            {/* Promo section */}
            {(branch as any).promoPreview && (
              <div className="rounded-md border border-[#045693]/30 bg-primary/5 p-3">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-primary mb-1">
                  Promo Aktif
                </p>
                {(() => {
                  const p = (branch as any).promoPreview;
                  const checklist = Array.isArray(p?.checklist) ? (p.checklist as string[]) : [];
                  return (
                    <div className="text-sm text-foreground">
                      <p className="font-medium">{p?.title ?? 'Promo'}</p>
                      {checklist.length > 0 && (
                        <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-5">
                          {checklist.slice(0, 5).map((item: string, idx: number) => (
                            <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}
              </div>
            )}
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Slot Tersedia Hari Ini</p>
              <BookingSlotList slots={branch.slots} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  onBranchClick?.(branch);
                  router.push(`/workshop/${branch.id}`);
                }}
                className="rounded-full border-[#045693]/40 px-5 text-primary hover:border-[#045693] hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"
                aria-label={`Pilih ${branch.name}`}
              >
                Pilih Bengkel
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking'
import { BookingSlotList } from './BookingSlotList'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'


type BookingBranchListProps = {
  branches: BookingBranch[];
  onBranchClick?: (branch: BookingBranch) => void;
};

export function BookingBranchList({ branches, onBranchClick }: BookingBranchListProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [openPromoId, setOpenPromoId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Tidak ada bengkel yang cocok dengan filter saat ini. Coba pilih kota lain atau sesuaikan
        kata kunci pencarian.
      </p>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      {branches.map((branch) => (
        <Card
          key={branch.id}
          className="border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#045693] hover:shadow-md"
        >
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-[#045693]/40 pb-4">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {branch.name}
                </CardTitle>
                {/* Category name */}
                {branch.company?.name && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.company.name}</p>
                )}
                {/* Type name (jika ada) */}
                {(branch as any).typeName && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{(branch as any).typeName}</p>
                )}
              </div>
              {/* Promo badge */}
              {(branch as any).promoPreview && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setOpenPromoId((curr) => (curr === branch.id ? null : branch.id))
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-yellow-200"
                  aria-expanded={openPromoId === branch.id}
                >
                  🏷️ Promo
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            {(branch.address || branch.district) && (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {[branch.address, branch.district].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
              </p>
            )}
            {branch.phone && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.phone}</p>}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-4">
            {/* Promo panel (toggle) */}
            {openPromoId === branch.id && (branch as any).promoPreview && (
              <div className="rounded-md border border-[#045693]/30 bg-primary/5 p-3">
                {(() => {
                  const p = (branch as any).promoPreview as {
                    title?: string
                    checklist?: string[]
                  }
                  const checklist = Array.isArray(p?.checklist) ? p!.checklist! : []
                  return (
                    <div className="text-sm text-foreground">
                      <p className="font-medium">{p?.title ?? 'Promo'}</p>
                      {checklist.length > 0 && (
                        <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-5">
                          {checklist.map((item, idx) => (
                            <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                })()}
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Slot Tersedia Hari Ini</p>
              <BookingSlotList slots={branch.slots} />
            </div>
            {/* Link alamat (opsional) */}
            {branch.address && (
              <div>
                <a
                  className="text-sm text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                  href={`https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(
                    `${branch.name} ${branch.address}`,
                  )}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                >
                  Lihat lokasi di Google Maps
                </a>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  onBranchClick?.(branch)
                  router.push(`/workshop/${branch.id}`)
                }}
                className="rounded-full border-[#045693]/40 px-5 text-primary hover:border-[#045693] hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"
                aria-label={`Pilih ${branch.name}`]
              >
                Pilih Bengkel
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists as useWL } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

interface ExtendedBranch extends BookingBranch {
  typeName?: string | null;
  promoPreview?: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    promoType: string;
    checklist?: string[] | null;
  } | null;
}

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: { variant?: BookingCTAVariant }) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWL();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeBranch, setActiveBranch] = useState<BookingBranch | null>(null);

  const branches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    return (waitingLists as any[]).map((item: any) => {
      const typeName =
        Array.isArray(item?.workshopTypes) && item.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? item.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : null;
      const b: ExtendedBranch = {
        ...(item as BookingBranch),
        // focus on name/category; hide location in card header for now
        city: null as any,
        district: null as any,
        typeName,
        promoPreview: item?.promoPreview ?? null,
        slots: [],
      };
      return b;
    });
  }, [waitingLists]);

  const filteredBranches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    const normalized = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    const askPromo = /\bpromo\b/.test(normalized);
    return (branches as ExtendedBranch[]).filter((b) => {
      const p = b.promoPreview;
      const promoHit = !!(
        p &&
        [p.title]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .some((t) => String(t).toLowerCase().includes(normalized))
      );
      const textHit =
        normalized.length === 0 ||
        b.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
        (b.company?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
        (b.typeName ? b.typeName.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) : false) ||
        promoHit;
      if (askPromo) {
        return !!p && textHit;
      }
      return textHit;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <section className={variant === 'section' ? 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]' : 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'}>
      <div
        className={
          variant === 'section'
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">Promo &amp; Bengkel</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">
            Temukan Bengkel Promo di Sekitar Anda
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Ketik nama bengkel, jenis layanan, atau kata kunci seperti “promo”. Aktifkan chip Promo untuk
            melihat bengkel yang sedang ada promo.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Daftar Bengkel
          </p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches as any} onBranchClick={setActiveBranch} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

Backend
- Menambah promoPreview di list:
  - `waiting-list.service.ts`: select 1 promo aktif per WL dan map ke `hasPromo` + `promoPreview` (id, title, promoType, checklist[0..5]).
  - `response-waiting-list.dto.ts`: tambah field `hasPromo`, `promoPreview`.
- Endpoint promo detail:
  - GET `/waiting-list/:id/promo` sekarang dilindungi `@Roles('ADMIN','READ')` (untuk detail penuh bila dibutuhkan).

Frontend
- `BookingCTA.tsx`:
  - Hanya Search Bar; filter “promo” menampilkan WL yang punya `promoPreview`.
  - Tidak memanggil endpoint promo per-id lagi; pakai `promoPreview` dari list.
  - Inject `typeName` dari `workshopTypes[0]?.name`.
- `BookingBranchList.tsx`:
  - Header kartu: Nama Bengkel, `categoryName` (company.name), `typeName`.
  - Promo: badge “🏷️ Promo” (warna kuning). Klik untuk toggle panel “Promo Aktif” dengan judul dan checklist (semua item).
  - Lokasi: tombol “Lihat lokasi di Google Maps” yang membuka alamat di Maps.

Cara uji cepat
- Restart backend (agar field `promoPreview` ikut dipetakan).
- Hard refresh UI.
- Ketik “promo” di search → kartu WL dengan promo tampil; klik badge “🏷️ Promo” untuk membuka daftar benefit.
- Ketik nama bengkel (atau sebagian) → filter berdasarkan nama/jenis/label promo.

Jika ingin, saya bisa:

- Menambahkan ribbon kecil “PROMO” di sudut kartu agar lebih eyecatching.

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists as useWL } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

interface WaitingListListItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  address?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  mobile?: string | null;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  categoryName?: string | null;
  workshopTypes?: Array<{ id: string; name: string | null }>;
  promoPreview?: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    promoType: string;
    checklist?: string[] | null;
  } | null;
}

interface ExtendedBranch extends BookingBranch {
  typeName?: string | null;
  promoPreview?: WaitingListListItem['promoPreview'];
}

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: { variant?: BookingCTAVariant }) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWL();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');

  const branches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    const items = waitingLists as WaitingListListItem[];
    return items.map((item) => {
      const typeName =
        Array.isArray(item.workshopTypes) && item.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? item.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : null;
      const b: ExtendedBranch = {
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        city: null,
        district: null,
        address: item.address ?? null,
        phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
        company: { id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN', name: item.categoryName ?? item.name },
        slots: [],
        typeName,
        promoPreview: item.promoPreview ?? null,
      };
      return b;
    });
  }, [waitingLists]);

  const filteredBranches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    const normalized = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    const askPromo = /\bpromo\b/.test(normalized);
    return branches.filter((b) => {
      const p = b.promoPreview;
      const promoHit = !!(
        p &&
        [p.title]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .some((t) => String(t).toLowerCase().includes(normalized))
      );
      const textHit =
        normalized.length === 0 ||
        b.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
        (b.company?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(normalized) ||
        (b.typeName ? b.typeName.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) : false) ||
        promoHit;
      if (askPromo) {
        return !!p && textHit;
      }
      return textHit;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <section className={variant === 'section' ? 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]' : 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'}>
      <div
        className={
          variant === 'section'
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">Promo &amp; Bengkel</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">Temukan Bengkel Promo di Sekitar Anda</h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
            Ketik nama bengkel, jenis layanan, atau kata kunci seperti “promo”.
          </p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Daftar Bengkel</p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

Ringkas perubahan penting:

- `app/booking/components/BookingCTA.tsx`: sederhanakan ke Search Bar, filter “promo”, mapping `typeName` dan `promoPreview` dari response list, buang state yang tak dipakai.

**User**

Ok sip, sekarang pindahkan Lihat lokasi di Goole Maps tepat di bawah alamat, pada baris kode yg saya blok, serta tampilkan nomor hp dalam bentuk wa bubble saja, jadi nanti jika ada banyak bengkel , user akan mudah menghubunginya hanya dengak klik bubble wa

---

**Cursor**

Saya akan memindahkan tautan Google Maps tepat di bawah alamat pada header kartu, dan mengganti tampilan nomor telepon menjadi tombol bubble WhatsApp yang bisa diklik. Setelah itu saya akan cek cepat linternya.

```typescriptreact
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking'
import { BookingSlotList } from './BookingSlotList'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'


type BookingBranchListProps = {
  branches: BookingBranch[];
  onBranchClick?: (branch: BookingBranch) => void;
};

export function BookingBranchList({ branches, onBranchClick }: BookingBranchListProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [openPromoId, setOpenPromoId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Tidak ada bengkel yang cocok dengan filter saat ini. Coba pilih kota lain atau sesuaikan
        kata kunci pencarian.
      </p>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      {branches.map((branch) => {
        const waNumber = (branch.phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
        const waLink = waNumber ? `https://wa.me/${waNumber}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Halo, saya tertarik dengan layanan bengkel Anda.')}` : ''
        const mapsLink = branch.address
          ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(`${branch.name} ${branch.address}`)}`
          : ''
        return (
          <Card
            key={branch.id}
            className="border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#045693] hover:shadow-md"
          >
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-[#045693]/40 pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {branch.name}
                  </CardTitle>
                  {branch.company?.name && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.company.name}</p>
                  )}
                  {(branch as any).typeName && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{(branch as any).typeName}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {waLink && (
                    <a
                      href={waLink}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-green-500 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-600"
                      aria-label="Hubungi via WhatsApp"
                    >
                      💬 WhatsApp
                    </a>
                  )}
                  {(branch as any).promoPreview && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setOpenPromoId((curr) => (curr === branch.id ? null : branch.id))}
                      className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-yellow-800 hover:bg-yellow-200"
                      aria-expanded={openPromoId === branch.id}
                    >
                      🏷️ Promo
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              {(branch.address || branch.district) && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {[branch.address, branch.district].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
                  </p>
                  {mapsLink && (
                    <a
                      className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                      href={mapsLink}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    >
                      Lihat lokasi di Google Maps
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-4">
              {openPromoId === branch.id && (branch as any).promoPreview && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-[#045693]/30 bg-primary/5 p-3">
                  {(() => {
                    const p = (branch as any).promoPreview as {
                      title?: string
                      checklist?: string[]
                    }
                    const checklist = Array.isArray(p?.checklist) ? p!.checklist! : []
                    return (
                      <div className="text-sm text-foreground">
                        <p className="font-medium">{p?.title ?? 'Promo'}</p>
                        {checklist.length > 0 && (
                          <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-5">
                            {checklist.map((item, idx) => (
                              <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Slot Tersedia Hari Ini</p>
                <BookingSlotList slots={branch.slots} />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onBranchClick?.(branch)
                    router.push(`/workshop/${branch.id}`)
                  }}
                  className="rounded-full border-[#045693]/40 px-5 text-primary hover:border-[#045693] hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"
                  aria-label={`Pilih ${branch.name}`}
                >
                  Pilih Bengkel
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}



```

Sudah saya ubah:
- Tautan “Lihat lokasi di Google Maps” sekarang tepat di bawah alamat (header kartu).
- Nomor HP diganti menjadi bubble WhatsApp hijau; klik akan membuka chat ke nomor tersebut di WhatsApp.

Silakan refresh dan cek satu kartu:
- Baris: Nama → categoryName → typeName
- Alamat
- Link “Lihat lokasi di Google Maps”
- Bubble “💬 WhatsApp” di kanan atas (sebelah badge Promo) untuk kontak cepat.

```typescriptreact
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking'
// Removed BookingSlotList import because slots are not shown now
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'


type BookingBranchListProps = {
  branches: BookingBranch[];
  onBranchClick?: (branch: BookingBranch) => void;
};

export function BookingBranchList({ branches, onBranchClick }: BookingBranchListProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [openPromoId, setOpenPromoId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Tidak ada bengkel yang cocok dengan filter saat ini. Coba pilih kota lain atau sesuaikan
        kata kunci pencarian.
      </p>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      {branches.map((branch) => {
        const waNumber = (branch.phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
        const waLink = waNumber ? `https://wa.me/${waNumber}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Halo, saya tertarik dengan layanan bengkel Anda.')}` : ''
        const mapsLink = branch.address
          ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(`${branch.name} ${branch.address}`)}`
          : ''
        const handleOpenDetail = () => {
          onBranchClick?.(branch)
          router.push(`/workshop/${branch.id}`)
        }
        return (
          <Card
            key={branch.id}
            className="border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#045693] hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer"
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            onClick={handleOpenDetail}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') handleOpenDetail()
            }}
            aria-label={`Buka detail ${branch.name}`}
          >
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-[#045693]/40 pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {branch.name}
                  </CardTitle>
                  {branch.company?.name && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.company.name}</p>
                  )}
                  {(branch as any).typeName && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{(branch as any).typeName}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {waLink && (
                    <a
                      href={waLink}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-green-500 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-600"
                      aria-label="Hubungi via WhatsApp"
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    >
                      💬 WhatsApp
                    </a>
                  )}
                  {(branch as any).promoPreview && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation()
                        setOpenPromoId((curr) => (curr === branch.id ? null : branch.id))
                      }}
                      className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-yellow-800 hover:bg-yellow-200"
                      aria-expanded={openPromoId === branch.id}
                    >
                      🏷️ Promo
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              {(branch.address || branch.district) && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {[branch.address, branch.district].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
                  </p>
                  {mapsLink && (
                    <a
                      className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                      href={mapsLink}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    >
                      Lihat lokasi di Google Maps
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-4">
              {openPromoId === branch.id && (branch as any).promoPreview && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-[#045693]/30 bg-primary/5 p-3" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  {(() => {
                    const p = (branch as any).promoPreview as {
                      title?: string
                      checklist?: string[]
                    }
                    const checklist = Array.isArray(p?.checklist) ? p!.checklist! : []
                    return (
                      <div className="text-sm text-foreground">
                        <p className="font-medium">{p?.title ?? 'Promo'}</p>
                        {checklist.length > 0 && (
                          <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-5">
                            {checklist.map((item, idx) => (
                              <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
```

Hasilnya, header hanya berisi nama/kategori/tipe + alamat + link Maps, lalu tepat di bawahnya ada baris aksi: WhatsApp dan Promo.

---

**Cursor**

Saya akan memindahkan baris aksi (WhatsApp + Promo) ke bagian paling bawah kartu (CardContent), tetap bisa diklik tanpa membuka detail, dan menampilkan panel promo di atasnya bila dibuka. Saya akan lakukan edit sekarang.

```typescriptreact
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking'
// Removed BookingSlotList import because slots are not shown now
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'


type BookingBranchListProps = {
  branches: BookingBranch[];
  onBranchClick?: (branch: BookingBranch) => void;
};

export function BookingBranchList({ branches, onBranchClick }: BookingBranchListProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [openPromoId, setOpenPromoId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Tidak ada bengkel yang cocok dengan filter saat ini. Coba pilih kota lain atau sesuaikan
        kata kunci pencarian.
      </p>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      {branches.map((branch) => {
        const waNumber = (branch.phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
        const waLink = waNumber ? `https://wa.me/${waNumber}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Halo, saya tertarik dengan layanan bengkel Anda.')}` : ''
        const mapsLink = branch.address
          ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(`${branch.name} ${branch.address}`)}`
          : ''
        const handleOpenDetail = () => {
          onBranchClick?.(branch)
          router.push(`/workshop/${branch.id}`)
        }
        const hasPromoOpen = openPromoId === branch.id && (branch as any).promoPreview
        return (
          <Card
            key={branch.id}
            className="border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white shadow-sm transition hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#045693] hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer"
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            onClick={handleOpenDetail}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') handleOpenDetail()
            }}
            aria-label={`Buka detail ${branch.name}`}
          >
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-[#045693]/40 pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {branch.name}
                  </CardTitle>
                  {branch.company?.name && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.company.name}</p>
                  )}
                  {(branch as any).typeName && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{(branch as any).typeName}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              {(branch.address || branch.district) && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {[branch.address, branch.district].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
                  </p>
                  {mapsLink && (
                    <a
                      className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                      href={mapsLink}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    >
                      Lihat lokasi di Google Maps
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-3">
              {hasPromoOpen && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-[#045693]/30 bg-primary/5 p-3 mb-3" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  {(() => {
                    const p = (branch as any).promoPreview as {
                      title?: string
                      checklist?: string[]
                    }
                    const checklist = Array.isArray(p?.checklist) ? p!.checklist! : []
                    return (
                      <div className="text-sm text-foreground">
                        <p className="font-medium">{p?.title ?? 'Promo'}</p>
                        {checklist.length > 0 && (
                          <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-5">
                            {checklist.map((item, idx) => (
                              <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {waLink && (
                  <a
                    href={waLink}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-green-500 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-600"
                    aria-label="Hubungi via WhatsApp"
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  >
                    💬 WhatsApp
                  </a>
                )}
                {(branch as any).promoPreview && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation()
                      setOpenPromoId((curr) => (curr === branch.id ? null : branch.id))
                    }}
                    className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-yellow-800 hover:bg-yellow-200"
                    aria-expanded={openPromoId === branch.id}
                  >
                    🏷️ Promo
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}



```

Sudah saya pindahkan bubble WhatsApp dan tag Promo ke area paling bawah kartu (di dalam CardContent). Panel promo jika dibuka akan muncul tepat di atas baris aksi ini. Klik pada keduanya tetap tidak membuka detail bengkel.

Ok sip aman. ketika saya ketik promo kenapa tidak ada Bengkel yg tampil?

---

**Cursor**

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists as useWL } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

interface WaitingListListItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  address?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  mobile?: string | null;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  categoryName?: string | null;
  workshopTypes?: Array<{ id: string; name: string | null }>;
  promoPreview?: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    promoType: string;
    checklist?: string[] | null;
  } | null;
}

interface ExtendedBranch extends BookingBranch {
  typeName?: string | null;
  promoPreview?: WaitingListListItem['promoPreview'];
}

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: { variant?: BookingCTAVariant }) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWL();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');

  const branches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    const items = waitingLists as WaitingListListItem[];
    return items.map((item) => {
      const typeName =
        Array.isArray(item.workshopTypes) && item.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? item.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : null;
      const b: ExtendedBranch = {
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        city: null,
        district: null,
        address: item.address ?? null,
        phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
        company: { id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN', name: item.categoryName ?? item.name },
        slots: [],
        typeName,
        promoPreview: item.promoPreview ?? null,
      };
      return b;
    });
  }, [waitingLists]);

  const filteredBranches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    const normalized = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    const hasPromoKeyword = /\bpromo\b/.test(normalized);
    const rest = normalized.replace(/\bpromo\b/g, '').trim();

    return branches.filter((b) => {
      const p = b.promoPreview;
      const hasPromo = Boolean(p);

      // If user types 'promo' only → show all that have promo
      if (hasPromoKeyword && rest.length === 0) return hasPromo;

      const textHit =
        rest.length === 0 ||
        b.name.toLowerCase().includes(rest) ||
        (b.company?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(rest) ||
        (b.typeName ? b.typeName.toLowerCase().includes(rest) : false);

      if (hasPromoKeyword) {
        return hasPromo && textHit;
      }
      return textHit;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <section className={variant === 'section' ? 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#045693]' : 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#045693]'}>
      <div
        className={
          variant === 'section'
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary">Promo &amp; Bengkel</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">Temukan Bengkel Promo di Sekitar Anda</h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">Ketik nama bengkel, jenis layanan, atau kata kunci seperti “promo”.</p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#045693]/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Daftar Bengkel</p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}



```

Kemungkinan karena logika filter saat ketik “promo” masih ikut memeriksa kecocokan teks pada judul promo. Sudah saya ubah:

- Jika input hanya “promo” → tampilkan semua bengkel yang punya promo aktif (`promoPreview`), tanpa syarat lain.
- Jika input mengandung “promo …kata_lain…” → tampilkan bengkel yang punya promo aktif DAN cocok dengan sisa kata (tanpa kata “promo”) pada nama bengkel, kategori, atau type.

Silakan coba ketik “promo” lagi. Jika tetap kosong, berarti data list belum menyertakan `promoPreview` untuk item tersebut; beri tahu saya, nanti saya cek service list-nya.

---

**User**

Mantap, apa yang kamu rekomendasikan untuk penerapan SEO?

---

**Cursor**

Berikut rekomendasi SEO praktis untuk proyek ini (Next.js App Router):

- Metadata dasar
  - Gunakan `generateMetadata` per halaman/detail: title unik (nama bengkel + kota + “Promo”), meta description ringkas, `canonical`.
  - Tambahkan OpenGraph + Twitter Card, `og:image` dinamis untuk tiap bengkel/promo.

- Structured Data (JSON‑LD)
  - Halaman bengkel: `LocalBusiness` atau `AutoRepair` (name, address, geo, telephone, openingHours, sameAs).
  - Promo: `Offer`/`SpecialAnnouncement` tertaut ke bengkel.
  - FAQ (bila ada pertanyaan umum di halaman) dengan `FAQPage`.

- Arsitektur URL dan internal linking
  - URL bersih dan stabil: `/workshop/[id-or-slug]` (pertimbangkan slug nama-bengkel-kota).
  - Link internal kontekstual dari listing → detail → promo.
  - Breadcrumbs (UI + JSON‑LD).

- Sitemap & robots
  - `app/sitemap.ts`: index + listing + semua workshop.
  - `app/robots.ts`: izinkan crawling halaman publik, disallow endpoint API.
  - Perbarui sitemap saat ada bengkel/promo baru.

- Konten halaman detail
  - NAP konsisten (Name, Address, Phone), link `tel:` dan `wa.me`, link Maps.
  - Salin singkat layanan/keahlian, kategori, tipe, testimoni/ulasan bila ada.
  - Heading terstruktur: H1 nama bengkel, H2 kategori/layanan, H2 promo.

- Performa (Core Web Vitals)
  - Gambar via `next/image` (ukuran tepat, `priority` pada hero), lazy-load lainnya.
  - Split kode secukupnya; cache data server (React Query + revalidate) dan gunakan SSG/SSR sesuai kebutuhan.
  - Minimalkan CLS: ukuran gambar tetap, hindari layout shift saat promo panel toggle.

- Internasional/geo
  - Jika multi‑bahasa nanti: `hreflang`.
  - Sertakan `geo` (latitude/longitude) di JSON‑LD untuk pencarian lokal.

- Duplikasi & kanonikal
  - Pastikan 1 URL kanonik per bengkel (hindari query param jadi halaman).
  - 404/410 untuk bengkel yang dihapus; `noindex` untuk halaman non-publik.

- Analitik & monitoring
  - Pasang `next/script` untuk GA/GTM.
  - Pantau Coverage, Core Web Vitals, dan indeksasi di Search Console.

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import Script from 'next/script';

export function GoogleAnalytics({ gaId }: { gaId?: string }) {
  if (!gaId) {
    return null;
  }

  const isLocalhost =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hostname === 'localhost';
  const cookieDomain = isLocalhost ? 'localhost' : '.ngebengkel.com';
  const cookieFlags = isLocalhost ? '' : 'SameSite=None;Secure';

  return (
    <>
      <Script
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${gaId}`}
      />
      <Script
        id="google-analytics"
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
          __html: `
            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
            function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
            gtag('js', new Date());
            gtag('config', '${gaId}', {
              page_path: window.location.pathname,
              page_location: window.location.href,
              cookie_domain: '${cookieDomain}',
              cookie_flags: '${cookieFlags}',
              send_page_view: true
            });
          `,
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';

export function GoogleSearchConsoleVerification() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const existingMeta = document.querySelector(
      'meta[name="google-site-verification"]'
    );
    if (!existingMeta) {
      const meta = document.createElement('meta');
      meta.name = 'google-site-verification';
      meta.content = '-kDq-qfEa-I1RlrzQE4xTZaPzJlncPlFoGG22jKbXgc';
      document.head.appendChild(meta);
    }
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { gtagPageView, GA_MEASUREMENT_ID } from '@/lib/gtag';

export default function PageViewTracker() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) return;
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.gtag !== 'function') return;

    const origin =
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL ||
      (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : '');

    const url = `${origin}${pathname}${
      searchParams?.toString() ? `?${searchParams.toString()}` : ''
    }`;

    gtagPageView(url, document.title);
  }, [pathname, searchParams]);

  return null;
}
```

```typescript
export const GA_MEASUREMENT_ID = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID || '';

const isLocalhost =
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hostname === 'localhost';
const COOKIE_DOMAIN = isLocalhost ? 'localhost' : '.ngebengkel.com';

declare global {
  interface Window {
    gtag: (
      command: 'config' | 'event' | 'js' | 'set' | 'consent',
      targetId: string | Date,
      config?: Record<string, unknown>
    ) => void;
  }
}

export const initializeGA = () => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.gtag) {
    window.gtag('consent', 'default', {
      analytics_storage: 'denied',
      ad_storage: 'denied',
      functionality_storage: 'denied',
    });
  }
};

export const gtagPageView = (url: string, title?: string) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.gtag) {
    window.gtag('config', GA_MEASUREMENT_ID, {
      page_title: title || document.title,
      page_location: url,
      cookie_domain: COOKIE_DOMAIN,
      cookie_flags: isLocalhost ? '' : 'SameSite=None;Secure',
    });
  }
};

export const gtagEvent = ({
  action,
  category,
  label,
  value,
}: {
  action: string;
  category?: string;
  label?: string;
  value?: number;
}) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.gtag) {
    window.gtag('event', action, {
      event_category: category,
      event_label: label,
      value,
    });
  }
};

export const gtagCustomEvent = (
  eventName: string,
  parameters?: Record<string, unknown>
) => {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.gtag) {
    window.gtag('event', eventName, parameters);
  }
};
```

**Cursor**

Menurut saya itu strategi yang bagus, dengan catatan kita tata SEO dan arsitekturnya sejak awal supaya “otoritas” terkonsolidasi ke domain utama.

Rekomendasi praktis:
- Domain & Subdomain
  - Jadikan `ngebengkel.com` (listing) sebagai domain utama untuk konten publik yang ingin diindeks.
  - Gunakan subdomain (mis. `portal.ngebengkel.com` atau `register.ngebengkel.com`) khusus untuk pendaftaran WL/admin; idealnya noindex jika bukan untuk publik.

- GSC (Google Search Console)
  - Buat property terpisah untuk domain utama dan setiap subdomain (domain property bisa memudahkan pantauan keseluruhan).
  - Verifikasi keduanya, dan submit sitemap masing‑masing (domain utama punya `https://ngebengkel.com/sitemap.xml`, subdomain punya sitemap sendiri jika dibutuhkan).

- Sitemap & Canonical
  - Sitemap domain utama hanya berisi URL public yang memang ingin ranking.
  - Di halaman subdomain yang bersifat utilitas/pendaftaran, beri `noindex` atau pastikan tidak masuk ke sitemap.
  - Pastikan setiap halaman punya canonical yang konsisten (utamanya ke domain utama).

- Routing & 301 Redirects
  - Jika ada halaman yang “pindah” dari subdomain ke domain utama, set 301 redirect permanen.
  - Hindari duplikasi konten antara domain utama dan subdomain; jika harus menampilkan ringkasan, gunakan canonical ke halaman utama.

- Analytics
  - Pakai GA yang sama (cross-domain tracking) bila perlu mengukur journey user lintas domain/subdomain.
  - Pastikan cookie domain diset ke `.ngebengkel.com` agar sesi lebih stabil (sudah kita terapkan).

- Robots & Indexing
  - `robots.txt` domain utama: allow untuk konten publik; blokir route API dan halaman internal.
  - Subdomain pendaftaran: boleh di-allow untuk aset statis, tapi halaman form bisa diberi `noindex`.

- Link Internal
  - Dari domain utama, arahkan CTA pendaftaran ke subdomain (nofollow tidak perlu; cukup noindex di subdomain).
  - Breadcrumbs, schema, dan internal link fokus mendorong crawl pada halaman listing/detail bengkel.

- Keamanan & Teknis
  - CORS, JWT, dan cookie lintas subdomain: set `SameSite=None; Secure` bila perlu berbagi sesi.
  - Pastikan env BASE_URL sesuai domain final untuk OG/Twitter image absolute URL.

Jika setuju, berikut langkah eksekusi ringan yang bisa saya kerjakan cepat:
- Siapkan `robots.ts` dan `sitemap.ts` final untuk domain utama.
- Tambahkan `noindex` di layout subdomain pendaftaran.
- Review canonical di semua halaman public.
- Tambah 301 mapping (jika ada URL yang akan dipindah).

```typescript
import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next';

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  const baseUrl =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL?.replace(/\/+$/, '') ||
    'https://ngebengkel.com';

  return {
    rules: [
      {
        userAgent: '*',
        allow: ['/'],
        disallow: [
          '/api/', // proxy/API internal
          '/_next/', // assets handled by Next
          '/admin/', // jaga kalau ada route internal
        ],
      },
    ],
    sitemap: [`${baseUrl}/sitemap.xml`],
    host: baseUrl,
  };
}


```

```typescript
import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next';

type WaitingListItem = {
  id: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
};

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const baseUrl =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL?.replace(/\/+$/, '') ||
    'https://ngebengkel.com';

  const routes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    {
      url: `${baseUrl}/`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 1,
    },
  ];

  // Tambahkan halaman detail workshop dari daftar WL (opsional/tergantung koneksi)
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/waiting-list`, {
      // Sitemap dipanggil di server, tidak perlu kredensial browser
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      // Cache agar tidak menekan origin
      next: { revalidate: 3600 },
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = (await res.json()) as any;
      const items: WaitingListItem[] = Array.isArray(data?.data) ? data.data : Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      for (const item of items) {
        routes.push({
          url: `${baseUrl}/workshop/${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}`,
          lastModified: item.updatedAt ? new Date(item.updatedAt) : new Date(),
          changeFrequency: 'weekly',
          priority: 0.7,
        });
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Abaikan error agar sitemap tetap ter-generate minimal untuk halaman utama
  }

  return routes;
}
```

- Domain utama (listing-ngebengkel)
  - `app/robots.ts`: allow crawl untuk konten publik, disallow `/api/`, men-set `sitemap` dan `host` ke `https://ngebengkel.com` (atau `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` jika ada).
  - `app/sitemap.ts`: berisi URL beranda dan mencoba menambahkan URL detail workshop dari `/api/waiting-list` (fallback aman jika gagal fetch).

- Subdomain pendaftaran (website-ngebengkel)
  - `app/layout.tsx`: set `robots` noindex, nofollow (juga untuk GoogleBot) sehingga tidak diindeks.

Terkait GSC: karena keyword/metadata sama, tidak masalah saat `listing-ngebengkel` menjadi `ngebengkel.com`, yang penting:
- Property GSC domain utama (`ngebengkel.com`) tetap pakai sitemap dari domain utama.
- Property GSC subdomain pendaftaran terpisah (opsional), dan sudah noindex.

Jika ingin, saya bisa tambahkan `app/robots.ts` khusus di subdomain pendaftaran untuk menegaskan `Disallow: /`.

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BookingBranchList } from './BookingBranchList';
import { BookingSearchBar } from './BookingSearchBar';
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking';
import { useWaitingLists as useWL } from '@/queryHooks/useWaitingList';

type BookingCTAVariant = 'section' | 'dialog';

interface WaitingListListItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  address?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  mobile?: string | null;
  categoryId?: string | null;
  categoryName?: string | null;
  workshopTypes?: Array<{ id: string; name: string | null }>;
  promoPreview?: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    promoType: string;
    checklist?: string[] | null;
  } | null;
}

interface ExtendedBranch extends BookingBranch {
  typeName?: string | null;
  promoPreview?: WaitingListListItem['promoPreview'];
}

export function BookingCTA({ variant = 'section' }: { variant?: BookingCTAVariant }) {
  const { data: waitingLists, isLoading, isError } = useWL();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');

  const branches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!waitingLists) return [];
    const items = waitingLists as WaitingListListItem[];
    return items.map((item) => {
      const typeName =
        Array.isArray(item.workshopTypes) && item.workshopTypes.length > 0
          ? item.workshopTypes[0]?.name ?? null
          : null;
      const b: ExtendedBranch = {
        id: item.id,
        name: item.name,
        city: null,
        district: null,
        address: item.address ?? null,
        phone: item.phone ?? item.mobile ?? null,
        company: { id: item.categoryId ?? 'UNKNOWN', name: item.categoryName ?? item.name },
        slots: [],
        typeName,
        promoPreview: item.promoPreview ?? null,
      };
      return b;
    });
  }, [waitingLists]);

  const filteredBranches: ExtendedBranch[] = useMemo(() => {
    const normalized = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    const hasPromoKeyword = /\bpromo\b/.test(normalized);
    const rest = normalized.replace(/\bpromo\b/g, '').trim();

    return branches.filter((b) => {
      const p = b.promoPreview;
      const hasPromo = Boolean(p);

      // If user types 'promo' only → show all that have promo
      if (hasPromoKeyword && rest.length === 0) return hasPromo;

      const textHit =
        rest.length === 0 ||
        b.name.toLowerCase().includes(rest) ||
        (b.company?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(rest) ||
        (b.typeName ? b.typeName.toLowerCase().includes(rest) : false);

      if (hasPromoKeyword) {
        return hasPromo && textHit;
      }
      return textHit;
    });
  }, [branches, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <section className={variant === 'section' ? 'w-full bg-white py-12 text-[#2f2f2f]' : 'w-full rounded-3xl bg-background text-[#2f2f2f]'}>
      <div
        className={
          variant === 'section'
            ? 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-0'
            : 'mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-gray-200 bg-background/95 px-6 py-8 shadow-xl sm:px-10 sm:py-10'
        }
      >
        <header className="space-y-2 text-left">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-muted-foreground">Promo &amp; Bengkel</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-foreground sm:text-4xl">Temukan Bengkel Promo di Sekitar Anda</h1>
          <p className="max-w-3xl text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">Ketik nama bengkel, jenis layanan, atau kata kunci seperti “promo”.</p>
        </header>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <BookingSearchBar value={searchTerm} onChange={setSearchTerm} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">Daftar Bengkel</p>
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Memuat daftar bengkel...</p>
          ) : isError ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">Gagal memuat daftar bengkel.</p>
          ) : (
            <BookingBranchList branches={filteredBranches} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client';
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import type { BookingBranch } from '@/types/booking'
// Removed BookingSlotList import because slots are not shown now
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'


type BookingBranchListProps = {
  branches: BookingBranch[];
  onBranchClick?: (branch: BookingBranch) => void;
};

export function BookingBranchList({ branches, onBranchClick }: BookingBranchListProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [openPromoId, setOpenPromoId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Tidak ada bengkel yang cocok dengan filter saat ini. Coba pilih kota lain atau sesuaikan
        kata kunci pencarian.
      </p>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      {branches.map((branch) => {
        const waNumber = (branch.phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
        const waLink = waNumber ? `https://wa.me/${waNumber}?text=${encodeURIComponent('Halo, saya tertarik dengan layanan bengkel Anda.')}` : ''
        const mapsLink = branch.address
          ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(`${branch.name} ${branch.address}`)}`
          : ''
        const handleOpenDetail = () => {
          onBranchClick?.(branch)
          router.push(`/workshop/${branch.id}`)
        }
        const hasPromoOpen = openPromoId === branch.id && (branch as any).promoPreview
        return (
          <Card
            key={branch.id}
            className="bg-white shadow-none border-0 rounded-xl transition hover:bg-gray-50/60 hover:ring-1 hover:ring-gray-200 cursor-pointer"
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            onClick={handleOpenDetail}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') handleOpenDetail()
            }}
            aria-label={`Buka detail ${branch.name}`}
          >
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-1 pb-2">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {branch.name}
                  </CardTitle>
                  {branch.company?.name && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{branch.company.name}</p>
                  )}
                  {(branch as any).typeName && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{(branch as any).typeName}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              {(branch.address || branch.district) && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {[branch.address, branch.district].filter(Boolean).join(' • ')}
                  </p>
                  {mapsLink && (
                    <a
                      className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                      href={mapsLink}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    >
                      Lihat lokasi di Google Maps
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-2">
              {hasPromoOpen && (
                <div className="mb-3 rounded-md bg-gray-100 p-3" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  {(() => {
                    const p = (branch as any).promoPreview as {
                      title?: string
                      checklist?: string[]
                    }
                    const checklist = Array.isArray(p?.checklist) ? p!.checklist! : []
                    return (
                      <div className="text-sm text-foreground">
                        <p className="font-medium">{p?.title ?? 'Promo'}</p>
                        {checklist.length > 0 && (
                          <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-5">
                            {checklist.map((item, idx) => (
                              <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })()}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {waLink && (
                  <a
                    href={waLink}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-green-500 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-green-600"
                    aria-label="Hubungi via WhatsApp"
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  >
                    💬 WhatsApp
                  </a>
                )}
                {(branch as any).promoPreview && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation()
                      setOpenPromoId((curr) => (curr === branch.id ? null : branch.id))
                    }}
                    className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-yellow-800 hover:bg-yellow-200"
                    aria-expanded={openPromoId === branch.id}
                  >
                    🏷️ Promo
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3 border-b border-gray-200" />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
```

**Cursor**

Ya. Urutannya seperti ini:
- Di mapping data: `phone` diisi dari `item.phone ?? item.mobile` → prioritas `phone`, kalau kosong pakai `mobile`.
- Di kartu: WA bubble membaca `branch.phone`, lalu dibersihkan ke digit saja sebelum membentuk `https://wa.me/...`.

Jadi sumbernya kolom `phone`, fallback ke `mobile` dari `wks_waitingList`.

**Cursor**

Dari tabel `wks_waitingList` (backend). Di-join/ambil juga:
- category: `wks_WorkshopCategory` → `categoryId`, `categoryName`
- type (opsional): `wks_WorkshopType` → `workshopTypes[0].name` (jadi `typeName`)
- promo (preview): `wks_promo` aktif → `promoPreview`

Field dasar (name, address, phone/mobile, dst) berasal langsung dari `wks_waitingList`.

Ya, format 6282245829969 didukung. Saya juga sudah menambahkan normalisasi nomor:
- Jika diawali 62 → dipakai apa adanya.
- Jika diawali 0 → diubah jadi 62… (contoh 0812… menjadi 62812…).
- Jika diawali 8 → ditambahkan 62 di depan.

Jadi nomor lokal seperti 0812… atau 812… otomatis jadi format internasional untuk `wa.me`.

```typescriptreact
                    className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-yellow-800 hover:bg-yellow-200"
                    aria-expanded={openPromoId === branch.id}
                  >
                    🏷️ Promo
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3 border-b border-gray-200" />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}



```
